# `billing_account`

Area: **party** ([all tables](README.md))

SID BillingAccount (TMF666 billingAccount, served as the BssBillingAccount extension): one customer, one currency, one bill cycle day. The balance is not stored: payments (done) minus all ABRs.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |
| `customer_id` | `uuid` | no |  | TMF666 relatedParty[0] with role customer (a PartyRoleRef to the Customer); fixed at creation. |
| `name` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `state` | `account_state` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | Active, Suspended or Closed (ours). Ordering refuses a non-Active account; billing ignores it (billed by dates alone). |
| `currency` | `character(3)` | no |  | ISO 4217 code, three upper-case letters. The account's single currency (BssBillingAccount extension); immutable. Target of the composite (id, currency) foreign keys. |
| `bill_cycle_day` | `smallint` | no |  | Day of month 1..28 on which the account's billing periods start (BssBillingAccount extension); fixed after creation. |
| `credit_limit` | `numeric(12,2)` | yes |  | numeric(12,2), exact (never float); TMF666 creditLimit in the account's currency; informational only, never refuses anything. NULL = none recorded. |
| `opened_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the account was created, by the injected clock. A billing run for D covers the accounts opened before 00:00 of D (BILLING_TZ). Unlike created_at, which is the database's now(). |
| `bill_format_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Optional renderer choice for future bills; default JSON detailed. |
| `financial_account_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Optional TMF666 financialAccount; owned by the party of the account's customer. |
| `cycle_specification_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | billStructure.cycleSpecification; NULL = the built-in monthly specification. |
| `description` | `text` | yes |  | TMF666 description. |
| `account_type` | `text` | yes |  | TMF666 accountType, a record only. |
| `details` | `jsonb` | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | TMF666 descriptive attributes (contact, paymentPlan, relatedParty as sent, ...), validated against the spec; billing never reads them. |
